name: SheetResizeHandle
description: Handle on the inner edge of the sheet that resizes it by dragging or with the arrow keys. Place it inside `Sheet.Popup`. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the handle, blocking drag and keyboard resizing.

props.name: step
props.description: Distance the sheet resizes per arrow-key press, in pixels.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Sheet.ResizeHandle.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
